description: Lambda functions must have X-Ray tracing enabled

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function has no TracingConfig property at all
requirements.rationale: When TracingConfig is absent, no X-Ray tracing configuration has been declared; the rule requires X-Ray tracing to be enabled (Mode set to Active or PassThrough).

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function has TracingConfig with Mode set to 'Active'
requirements.rationale: Active mode enables X-Ray tracing — the function samples and records incoming requests. Per resolved decision, this satisfies the rule.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function has TracingConfig with Mode set to 'PassThrough'
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision (lenient interpretation), any valid TracingConfig.Mode value (Active or PassThrough) is considered X-Ray tracing enabled.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function has a TracingConfig object but Mode property is absent inside it
requirements.rationale: Without an explicit Mode value (Active or PassThrough), no valid tracing configuration is asserted; the rule should flag.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function has TracingConfig.Mode set to an invalid value (e.g., 'Disabled', 'None', 'active' lowercase)
requirements.rationale: Lambda only accepts the case-sensitive values 'Active' or 'PassThrough'. Any other value is invalid and does not represent enabled X-Ray tracing.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function TracingConfig.Mode is set via an unresolvable intrinsic (e.g., Fn::If with two branches, Fn::ImportValue, Ref to a parameter without a default)
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision, when Mode cannot be statically resolved, the rule should not flag to avoid false positives.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function TracingConfig itself is gated by an unresolvable Fn::If (entire TracingConfig block conditional)
requirements.rationale: When the presence of TracingConfig itself depends on an unresolvable condition, the rule cannot assert non-compliance and should pass.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function TracingConfig is set to an empty object {}
requirements.rationale: An empty TracingConfig contains no Mode value; this is equivalent to Mode being absent and does not satisfy the rule.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function TracingConfig.Mode resolves to 'Active' through Fn::Sub or another statically resolvable intrinsic
requirements.rationale: When the Mode value can be statically resolved to 'Active' (or 'PassThrough'), the rule is satisfied.

requirements.description: AWS::Lambda::Function TracingConfig.Mode resolves via Ref to a CloudFormation Parameter with Default: 'Active' (and no AllowedValues forbidding it)
requirements.rationale: The resolvable default value is 'Active' which satisfies the rule. If treated as unresolvable by the engine, REQ-06 still mandates a pass.

requirements.description: Resource type is AWS::Serverless::Function (SAM) with or without Tracing property
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision, SAM functions are out of scope for this rule; only AWS::Lambda::Function is evaluated.

requirements.description: Resource type is a Lambda-related but non-function type (e.g., AWS::Lambda::LayerVersion, AWS::Lambda::Alias, AWS::Lambda::Version, AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping, AWS::Lambda::Permission)
requirements.rationale: These resources do not have a TracingConfig property and are not Lambda functions; the rule does not apply.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_lambda_function with tracing_config block where mode = "Active"
requirements.rationale: Equivalent to CloudFormation TracingConfig.Mode = Active; X-Ray tracing enabled.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_lambda_function with tracing_config block where mode = "PassThrough"
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision (lenient), PassThrough is treated as X-Ray tracing enabled.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_lambda_function with no tracing_config block
requirements.rationale: Without tracing_config, no tracing mode is declared; the rule should flag.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_lambda_function has tracing_config block but mode argument is omitted
requirements.rationale: Without an explicit mode, the configuration is incomplete and not considered as enabling X-Ray tracing.
Only 'Active' or 'PassThrough' are valid values; any other string is invalid and does not satisfy the rule.
